description: This Java class implements entity persistence operations for MongoDB in the context of an EventSource, providing methods to purge entities based on their IDs.

classes.name: MongoEntitiesPersistenceOperations
classes.description: Final class providing MongoDB-based persistence operations for entities in an EventSource context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of MongoEntitiesPersistenceOperations.

methods.name: purgeEntity
methods.description: Purges all data related to a specific entity identified by EntityId.

methods.name: selectEntity
methods.description: Selects the relevant MongoPersistenceOperationsSelection objects for a given EntityId.

methods.name: purgeAllSelections
methods.description: Merges the purge operations for all selected MongoPersistenceOperationsSelection objects.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Performs the actual delete operation on a MongoDB collection based on the selection.
